verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal. A built-in conversational AI agent is a fair axis for terminal products, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents no natural-language agent, repository insights or pull-request creation. Connecting to VS Code or GitHub Codespaces is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests
